data.description:
## Testing Mode: UPDATE (doc/instruction file changes only)

## What to update

### DD3: Update preplanning SKILL.md pointer references
In plugins/dso/skills/preplanning/SKILL.md, all instances of:
  <- Satisfies: "[quoted epic criterion]"
  <- Satisfies: "<quoted epic criterion>"
that annotate done definitions inside Phase H story templates should be updated to use the post-migration form:
  <- Validates Closure Check: "[quoted criterion]"

This is a pointer-form update: the story template guidance in Phase H currently uses "Satisfies:" as the annotation; after the Closure Checks migration (S8), the canonical form is "Validates Closure Check:". Update the template examples so stories created after S3 closure use the correct post-migration form.

Scope: ONLY update the done-definition annotation form in the story template. Do NOT change the descriptive prose about what done definitions are (lines 634+, which describe the cross-check behavior). The "Satisfies Criterion" column header in the story table at line 800 is a column header, not a pointer annotation — leave it unchanged.

Lines to update (check current line numbers before editing):
- Lines ~554, ~556: template done-definition lines with <- Satisfies: "<quoted epic criterion>"
- Lines ~605, ~607: another template block using same form
- Lines ~616, ~619: example block showing concrete usage

For each, change the annotation prefix from "<- Satisfies:" to "<- Validates Closure Check:".

### DD4: CLAUDE_MD_SUGGESTED_CHANGE report

IMPORTANT: Per CLAUDE.md architectural rules, do NOT directly edit CLAUDE.md.
Instead, emit the following report at the end of this task's output:

---
CLAUDE_MD_SUGGESTED_CHANGE:
Section: Quick Reference table
Action: ADD row
After: "| List tickets ready to work | ... |"
Row to add:
| Audit planning artifacts for Closure Checks migration | .claude/scripts/dso audit-closure-checks-migration.sh |

Rationale: DD4 requires a CLAUDE.md Quick Reference row for the audit script.
Per CLAUDE.md architecture rules, CLAUDE.md is edited only by the orchestrator
after reviewing this suggestion. The row helps release engineers discover the
script during migration planning.
---

## Verify
Run: grep -n "Validates Closure Check" plugins/dso/skills/preplanning/SKILL.md
Expected: 3-6 lines updated (the template annotation instances)

Run: grep -c "Satisfies:" plugins/dso/skills/preplanning/SKILL.md  
Expected: count should drop by the number of template annotation lines updated
(prose references at lines 634+ are preserved)
data.title: Update preplanning SKILL.md pointer annotations to Validates Closure Check form and emit CLAUDE.md Quick Reference suggestion
